DEEPTI PRIYA MARPU

Professional Summary: 
Senior Business Analyst with 10 years of experience in Banking and Financial Services, specializing in 
Retail Banking Operations, Trade Finance and Payments domain. Strong expertise in Business Process 
analysis, BPMN 2.0 process modelling, and digital transformation initiatives. Proven expertise in 
designing end-to-end process models, and translating complex banking requirements into BRDs, FRDs, 
and User stories. Proven ability to partner with senior stakeholders, drive process optimization and 
automation initiatives, support Agile delivery, and ensure regulatory and compliance alignment across 
digital banking solutions. 
Core Skills & Tools: 
▪ Banking Domains: Retail Banking, Trade Finance, Payments, Digital Banking. 
▪ Trade Finance: Letter of Credit (LC), Bank Guarantee, Collections. 
▪ Payments: ACH, NEFT, RTGS, Bulk Transfers, SWIFT, Message type-MT & MX. 
▪ Business Analysis: Requirement Gathering, BRD, FSD, User Stories, Use Cases, GAP Analysis. 
▪ Process Modelling & Transformation: Target Operating Model (TOM), BPMN 2.0, As-Is / To-Be 
Modelling, Process Architecture, Customer Journey Mapping, Process Optimization, 
Automation 
▪ Tools: Signavio, Apromore, MS Visio, Miro, JIRA. 
▪ Core & Trade Systems: Finacle, T24, Trade Pro, Finastra (FCC & FTI). 
▪ Data & Reporting: SQL (basic), Excel, KPI Analysis, Dashboard Support. 
▪ Delivery & Governance: Agile, SDLC, SIT/UAT, Stakeholder Management & Communication, 
SPOC for Clients. 
Professional Experience: 
A. KPMG-India: Senior Consultant: June 2026-Till date. 
•  Led end -to-end proposal development for strategic pursuits, coordinating with cross -
functional teams to deliver high-quality, client-centric proposals within tight deadlines. 
• Conducted market and competitor research, analyzed client requirements, and supported 
opportunity qualification to strengthen business development initiatives and improve win 
rates. 
• ⁠Collaborated with Partners, Directors, and Solution Leads to develop compelling value 
propositions, win themes, executive summaries, and differentiated solution narratives. 
• ⁠Maintained proposal knowledge repositories, reusable content libraries, and pursuit 
documentation to improve proposal efficiency, consistency, and governance across 
engagements. 
B. Deloitte India- Senior Consultant (Jan 2022-Present): 
▪ Managed end -to-end digital self -service banking through a web-based portal for Trade 
Finance system of a leading Middle East Bank, which enables Banks Trade Finance 
department to process transactions of different Trade Finance products like Letter of Credit 
(LC), Collections, Guarantees, using Finastra solutions FCC & FTI, further reducing the branch 
walk-in customers. 
▪ Customized process in FCC initiating Trade Finance requests like issuing Import LC, Export 
Collection, Undertaking Issued & Shipping Guarantee etc. for Corporate Banking customers 
and further integrating it to FTI & vice-versa. 
▪ Partnered with Business, Operations, Technology, and SME stakeholders to conduct 
process discovery workshops, analyse banking workflows, regulatory requirements, 
system dependencies, and identify opportunities for business process transformation and 
digital modernization. 
▪ Led BPMN 2.0 -based process modelling initiatives using Signavio for AS -IS process 
mapping, Customer Journey Mapping, Pain Point Analysis, TO -BE process design, and 
Process Architecture to support Trade Finance digital transformation initiatives. 
▪ Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives by defining future -state business 
processes, governance workflows, and process architecture for Trade Finance digital 
transformation, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements. 
▪ Created Business Requirement Document (BRD), Functional Requirement Document (FRD), 
Mock-ups, functional workflows, regulatory & compliance constraints through 
brainstorming & workshops with Business Users, SME interviews and regulatory review 
sessions.
▪ Converted requirements into Epics, User stories, Acceptance criteria and worked closely 
with Product owner to maintain Product backlog. 
▪ Facilitated requirement prioritization using MoSCoW, business value vs effort and ensured 
alignment between business priorities & scope. 
▪ Acted as bridge between business and technology, clarified requirements for development 
team & supported integrations with FCC, FTI & core banking system (T24). 
▪ Reviewed functional and UAT test cases, supported business users during UAT and managed 
defect triage and resolution. 
▪ Engaged in onshore deployments across Jordan, Iraq and KSA, ensuring seamless production 
rollout and successful adoption of digital channels to replace branch-based workflows. 
 
 
C. RBL Bank- Process Lead (Oct 2018- Jan 2022): 
▪ Led end-to-end Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) development for backend Banking 
operations (e.g. Retail Banking & Trade Operations), by converting informal processes into 
standardized, audit-ready documentation aligned with regulatory and internal policies. 
▪ Led business process transformation initiatives across Retail Banking and Trade Operations 
by assessing AS -IS operating processes and designing TO -BE process flows to improve 
operational efficiency, governance, compliance, and operational controls. 
▪ Conducted detailed process walkthroughs, SME interviews, and live process observations to 
capture current -state workflows, validate system touchpoints, hands -off, and inter -unit 
dependencies. 
▪ Partnered with Business stakeholders, SMEs, Operations, Technology, Risk, and Compliance 
teams to conduct process discovery workshops, identify pain points, document current -
state workflows, and define future -state business processes aligned with business and 
regulatory objectives. 
▪ Designed BPMN -compliant process maps using MS Visio, along with RACI matrices, 
checklists, and hands-off procedures to ensure clarity of ownership, controls, and SLAs. 
▪ Embedded operational risk controls, maker-checker mechanisms, approval frameworks, and 
mitigation measures within SOPs to strengthen compliance and operational resilience. 
▪ Collaborated closely with Operations, Business, Technology, Compliance, Risk, and Audit 
teams to review, validate, and govern SOPs through structured version control and approval 
workflows. 
▪ Supported internal, external, and regulatory audits by maintaining accurate SOP repositories, 
tracking adherence, and resolving process deviations and audit observations. 
▪ Drove periodic process reviews and re-engineering initiatives to address regulatory changes, 
system upgrades, audit findings, and business enhancements, improving efficiency and risk 
posture. 
▪ Contributed to the design and refinement of the Target Operating Model (TOM) by 
standardizing operational processes, governance frameworks, roles and responsibilities 
(RACI), approval workflows, and control mechanisms across Retail Banking and Trade 
Operations. 
▪ Identified opportunities for process simplification, digitization, and automation; performed 
feasibility and risk analysis; and articulated business requirements for technology enabled 
solutions. 
▪ Acted as a Business analyst for automation initiatives, working with system designer, 
developers, and QA teams to implement process improvements and digital transformation 
solutions. 
▪ Managed priorities aligned with business requirements, monitored process KPIs, provided 
timely stakeholder updates, and ensured on -time delivery while adhering to organizational 
standards and regulatory guidelines. 
D. Hinduja Global Solutions- Process Consultant (Mar 2015-Oct 2017): 
▪ Worked as Business Analyst on a leading South African bank Trade finance transformation 
project to replace physical document handling with a centralized ticket -based portal, 
enabling automated request routing, role -based access control, and end -to end visibility 
across Trade finance operations. 
▪ Collaborated with Trade Finance leadership, branch operations, and backend teams to 
analyse delays caused by physical document movement, lack of request visibility, manual 
tracking, and inefficient segregation of Letters of Credit (LCs). 
▪ Defined key business objectives, including creation of a single digital entry point for Trade 
finance requests, automated routing to respective backend teams, controlled access and 
improved auditability and compliance. 
▪ Identified and engaged relevant stakeholder for requirements elicitation, validation and 
sign-offs, ensuring alignment across business, operations, and technology teams. 
▪ Documented As-Is and To-Be process flows using MS Visio. 
▪ Gathered and documented functional & non-functional requirements, preparing BRDs, 
FRDs, Epics, and User stories with clearly defined acceptance criteria. 
▪ Defined requirements for operational dashboards to support request tracking, SLA 
monitoring and workload management for Trade Finance operations teams. 
▪ Supported development teams by providing requirement clarifications, managing change 
requests, and performing impact analysis throughout the delivery lifecycle. 
▪ Assisted with UAT by coordinating with branch and backend teams, validating business 
scenarios, ensuring defect resolution and obtaining business sign-off. 
▪ Supported production deployment, conducted user training for branch and backend teams, 
and ensured successful adoption of the portal to fully replace physical document submission.
